description:
Bring your app’s saved marketing context into the conversation. DistributionOS helps you review your audience and positioning, find existing next actions, read saved plans and briefs, and save a new marketing plan for review. Return in a later conversation to pick up the same work.

Connect your DistributionOS account and choose an app with an active subscription. This plugin reads saved workspace information and saves proposed plans. It does not publish or schedule content, send outreach, generate images, run paid research, change billing, or execute tasks.

defaultPrompt: Review my app’s saved marketing context and help me choose one existing next action.
Find my saved marketing plans and summarize the one I choose.
Use my saved app context to draft a small marketing plan and save it for my review.
